description: Discover valid values for ClinicalTrials.gov fields with study counts per value. Use to explore available filter options before building a search — e.g., valid OverallStatus, Phase, InterventionType, StudyType, or LeadSponsorClass values.

anyOf.description: A single PascalCase leaf piece name.
Multiple PascalCase leaf piece names (at least one required).

fields.description: PascalCase leaf piece name(s) to get value statistics for — an empty list is rejected, not treated as "every field". Index-only pieces count too (NumLocations, StudyFirstPostYear — listed by clinicaltrials_get_field_definitions in drill mode with includeIndexedOnly), as do legacy alt names such as OVERALL-STATUS; a search area such as ConditionSearch does not. A group of fields (LeadSponsor, ConditionMesh) is refused with its leaf pieces named (LeadSponsorName, ConditionMeshTerm), and a full path as clinicaltrials_get_field_definitions prints it ("protocolSection.statusModule.overallStatus") is read as its piece name. A comma- or pipe-joined string ("Phase,StudyType") is split into separate names. Examples: OverallStatus, Phase, StudyType, Sex, LeadSponsorClass. Use clinicaltrials_get_field_definitions with a query to find more field names.

name: clinicaltrials_get_field_values

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `blank_value`: A parameter was supplied with a blank, whitespace-only, or empty-list value. `field_invalid`: A requested name is not a field (a record or index-only piece such as NumLocations, or an alt name of one; a search area such as ConditionSearch is not), names a group of fields such as LeadSponsor or ConditionMesh instead of its leaf pieces, or names a leaf whose type ClinicalTrials.gov does not count, such as LocationGeoPoint. `request_too_long`: The fields list makes the request URL longer than ClinicalTrials.gov accepts — a few hundred piece names in one call. `rate_limited`: ClinicalTrials.gov answered HTTP 429 on every attempt, or the call’s time budget ran out after a 429. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: ClinicalTrials.gov did not answer within the call’s time budget, which covers every request, retry, and wait the call makes. `upstream_timeout`: ClinicalTrials.gov answered HTTP 504 (gateway timeout) or 408 (request timeout), or sent no answer within the per-attempt timeout, on every attempt. `upstream_unavailable`: Every attempt failed on ClinicalTrials.gov’s side — HTTP 500, 502, or 503, a dropped connection or one the network gave up opening, or a 200 body that is not the JSON the route serves (an HTML page, unparseable text, the wrong shape) — or it answered with another 5xx, such as 505, or the connection was refused or its host name did not resolve, none of which is retried. `upstream_rejected`: ClinicalTrials.gov refused the request with a status its API does not use for a bad query — HTTP 501, a 3xx, or a 4xx such as 401, 403, or 410 — or answered with an HTML error page in place of its own 404. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fieldStats.description: One entry per requested field: canonical path, PascalCase piece name, data type, and the statistics variant that type carries — top values with study counts plus unique/longest for ENUM/STRING, trueCount/falseCount for BOOLEAN, min/max/avg for INTEGER/NUMBER, min/max/formats for DATE.

items.description: Statistics for a single requested field.

avg.description: Mean of the recorded values. Present for INTEGER/NUMBER fields.

falseCount.description: Studies where field is false. Present for BOOLEAN fields.

formats.description: Date patterns this field is recorded in. Present for DATE fields; more than one means the field mixes precisions across studies.

longest.description: Longest recorded value with its length and a study carrying it. Present for STRING fields only.

length.description: Full length of the recorded value in characters, even when truncated.

nctId.description: NCT ID of a study carrying it.

truncated.description: True when value is a preview of at most 2,000 characters; absent when value is whole. The notice names the clinicaltrials_search_studies call that returns the full text.

value.description: The longest recorded value — when truncated is true, only a prefix of at most 2,000 characters (1,999 when the cut would split a surrogate pair).

anyOf.description: Largest value of an INTEGER/NUMBER field.
Latest value of a DATE field, at the precision recorded.

max.description: Largest recorded value — a number for INTEGER/NUMBER, a date string for DATE.

anyOf.description: Smallest value of an INTEGER/NUMBER field.
Earliest value of a DATE field, at the precision recorded — a partial date such as "1900-01" stays partial.

min.description: Smallest recorded value — a number for INTEGER/NUMBER, a date string for DATE.

missingStudiesCount.description: Number of studies where this field is absent.

multiValued.description: True when the field is repeated — array-typed itself (Phase, Condition) or nested under a repeated object (LocationCountry, one per site) — so a study can carry several values and the per-value studiesCount buckets sum above the study total. Use to avoid computing a percentage against the corpus. Absent for a single-valued field, and for any field the notice names as not determined.

topValues.description: Values ranked by frequency (capped at 250 by the API). Present for ENUM/STRING fields. When multiValued is true, studiesCount sums can exceed the study total.

items.description: A value and its study count.

studiesCount.description: Number of studies with this value.

trueCount.description: Studies where field is true. Present for BOOLEAN fields.

type.description: Field data type (ENUM, BOOLEAN, STRING, DATE, etc.).

uniqueValuesCount.description: Number of distinct values, as ClinicalTrials.gov reports it. Free-text STRING fields it does not count (DetailedDescription, EligibilityCriteria) report 0 here alongside uniqueValuesCounted: false — that 0 is not a count. A 0 without the flag means no recorded values.

uniqueValuesCounted.description: False when ClinicalTrials.gov did not count distinct values for this field, so the uniqueValuesCount of 0 is not a real count — the field has recorded values (see longest) but no topValues. Absent otherwise.

notice.description: Present when a longest value was cut to a preview — names, for each such field, the clinicaltrials_search_studies arguments that return its full text — or when multiValued could not be determined for a field, which then carries no multiValued flag and may be repeated.

title: Clinicaltrials Get Field Values
